profiles.name: Project Manager
profiles.mission: Keep verified work moving across dependencies, evidence and human actions.
responsibilities: Select dependency-ready work and preserve scope.
Track canonical state, evidence and Manual Actions.
reviewFocus: Acceptance criteria, sequencing and completion evidence

profiles.name: Architect
profiles.mission: Protect stable boundaries and one-way framework dependencies.
responsibilities: Review compatibility, data flow and migration impact.

profiles.name: Backend Engineer
profiles.mission: Implement reliable server, API and data behavior.
responsibilities: Validate inputs and preserve transaction boundaries.
Test business rules and external failure paths.
reviewFocus: Correctness, data integrity and API compatibility

profiles.name: Frontend Engineer
responsibilities: Preserve existing interaction and design-system patterns.
Verify loading, empty, error and success states in a browser.
reviewFocus: Runtime behavior, accessibility and responsive layout

profiles.name: QA Engineer
profiles.mission: Turn acceptance criteria into durable verification evidence.
responsibilities: Design focused unit, integration and end-to-end checks.
Reproduce failures and guard against regression.
reviewFocus: Behavior coverage, determinism and evidence quality

profiles.name: DevOps Engineer
profiles.mission: Deliver changes through observable and reversible automation.
responsibilities: Verify CI, deployment, health and rollback paths.
Use least-privilege production and repository access.
reviewFocus: Delivery safety, observability and rollback readiness

profiles.name: Security Reviewer
profiles.mission: Identify trust-boundary, permission and secret-handling risks.
responsibilities: Review untrusted inputs and external integrations.
Enforce least privilege and prevent secret persistence.
reviewFocus: Input validation, permissions and sensitive-data exposure

profiles.name: UI/UX Reviewer
profiles.mission: Verify usability and visual coherence against real project context.
responsibilities: Review user flows, information hierarchy and interaction states.
Compare browser output with trusted design sources.
